messages.content: The current subject.mjs lacks the interior-start surrogate check required by the contract. Submitting the patch:
messages.reasoning_content:
The supplied subject.mjs source: current file may deviate. The archive source shows the subject.mjs utf8 — but the actual file content sha is different (2d04...). The provided "inspected" source sha matches the mutation file hash, so that's the current content. Contract says: reject interior start (offset), move interior end backward. Current code: splitPair(end) -> end-- but doesn't validate interior start. Need: if splitPair(offset) reject? Also need(end>offset||...) handles progress. Add interior start check: need(!splitPair(offset),...). Also next_offset etc preserved.

Wait — "reject an interior start": if offset is in the middle of a surrogate pair (i.e., text[offset-1] is high surrogate and text[offset] low). splitPair(offset) checks exactly that. But also offset===0 fine. So add need(!splitPair(offset),'inspection-range-splits-unicode').
